envelope.description: Time-limit table, byte adapter and ghExec

body.title: Time-limit table, byte adapter and ghExec
body.summary: In helpers.ts add the per-job limit table and ghTimeoutMs, the byte-to-text adapter over runShellBytes, GhOutcome and ghExec with the key option, stdin input, cut-is-answer cap, abort signal and the one sign-in probe; no caller passes its own timeout. Carries its own unit tests.
acceptanceChecks: ghTimeoutMs returns the table limit for every existing tool and never less than its limit today, and the class default for an unknown key
ghExec always runs through runShellBytes, never puts input text in argv, and returns every runShellBytes field plus the limit applied and the probe result
the byte adapter yields valid text for a cut crossing a multibyte character

tests.name: gh-timeouts.test.ts: ghTimeoutMs gives each job the limit in the table and a missing key the class default
gh-timeouts.test.ts: no existing tool's limit is below its limit today
gh-capture.test.ts: byte-to-text adapter decodes with replacement and stays valid text when a cut crosses a multibyte character
gh-exec.test.ts: ghExec runs through runShellBytes, keeps input out of argv and returns the limit applied and the probe result
